title: Offline index rebuild plus VALIDATE on a constraint never created NOVALIDATE
expected_feedback: Standard, two issues. (1) ALTER INDEX REBUILD without ONLINE holds an exclusive lock for the whole rebuild and blocks DML on ORDERS; on 19c Enterprise Edition append ONLINE. (2) fk_orders_user is validated without ever having been created ENABLE NOVALIDATE in this script. The two-step pattern only avoids the blocking scan when step one actually was NOVALIDATE — if the constraint is currently DISABLED or was added validating, this statement takes the full-scan path under an exclusive lock, which is the cost the pattern exists to avoid. Check its current STATUS and VALIDATED in USER_CONSTRAINTS before running it.
violated_rule: Constraints use ENABLE NOVALIDATE + VALIDATE two-step

lint_detail_must_contain.ORA019: Use REBUILD ONLINE (available on Enterprise Edition).
